headline: ‘Act 46 all over again’: Gov. Phil Scott signs education reform bill, kick-starting a familiar process for voluntary school mergers
summary: Vermont passes H.955, promoting voluntary school district mergers beginning fall 2027, aiming for districts of at least 2,000 students by March 2028, impacting K-12 education structure and funding.

headline: Dunleavy vetoes nine bills, but Alaska lawmakers override two in special session flurry
summary: Gov. Dunleavy vetoed nine bills passed by Alaska legislature, including mental health education in schools and retirement plans for minimum-wage workers. Lawmakers overrode two vetos expanding pharmacists' powers and regulating interior design. Vetos on increased psychiatric facility oversight and corporate tax updates stood without votes. State budget not directly mentioned but overridden vetos could impact future spending priorities.
